Did a country really lose a war...
About twenty thousand emus marched onto farms in Western Australia and started eating the wheat.
Major Meredith arrived with soldiers, two machine guns, and ten thousand bullets.
The emus split into small groups and ran in every direction.
When a big flock came close, the gun jammed.
They mounted a gun on a truck, but the emus outran the truck.
Emus can run about fifty kilometers an hour.
After weeks of fighting, the soldiers claimed about a thousand birds...
using nearly ten bullets for each one.
The major even said that with soldiers as tough as these birds, he could face any army in the world.
